title: DC-area forecast: Showers arrive late tonight, last into at least part of Saturday
subtitle: HAPPENING NOW: Clouds thicken this evening as temperatures fall back through the 70s. A shower is possible before midnight, but any steadier rain holds off until later.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Clouds thicken this evening as temperatures fall back through the 70s. Showers hold off until late tonight.

What's next? Showers are possible at times tomorrow, but it’s a tricky forecast. Brighter and drier Sunday, then really nice Monday and Tuesday.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Turning cloudier and more humid through evening. Showers and some thunderstorms try to move in from the south sometime in the predawn hours. Lows are in the mid-60s to around 70. Confidence: Medium-High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow (Saturday): Models disagree whether scattered showers during the morning hours will give way to a mostly dry afternoon into evening, or if rain will continue at times during the afternoon into evening. The trend has been toward the drier afternoon/evening scenario, but that’s not a sure bet. Muggy highs in the mid-70s to near 80. Confidence: Medium

Tomorrow night: Another round of showers and storms is possible, if not during the evening then perhaps overnight. Fairly cloudy and calm with late-night fog possible. Humid 60s for lows. Total rain amounts could range from as little as around 0.25 inches, especially north and west of the Beltway, to an inch or more, especially south and east of the Beltway toward Southern Maryland. Confidence: Low-Medium

Sunday: Partly to mostly sunny with only a slight chance of a shower and slowly lowering humidity. Highs near 80 to mid-80s. Confidence: Medium

A look ahead

Sunday night: Clearing, calm, and probably dry. More comfortable lows in the upper 50s to mid-60s. Confidence: Medium

A blissful start to the workweek Monday and Tuesday, with comfortable humidity levels and temperatures. Highs are currently shooting for low to mid-80s both days. Plenty of sunshine expected, with rain chances near zero. Confidence: Medium

Shower and storm chances may return with a little bit more humidity and heat mid- to late week.

DC weather history for August 21

Repeated storms in 2018 dumped record rainfall with intense downpours, leading to flooding and marking one of the heaviest August rain events in years.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: A reasonably nice August Friday with less humidity.| 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
